summary: A short biographical note on Cedric Henderson, a 6'8" forward who played college basketball at the University of Georgia in the 1980s. He was drafted by the Atlanta Hawks in the second round of the 1986 NBA Draft and split the 1986-87 season between the Hawks and the Milwaukee Bucks, averaging modest numbers over 8 games.
one_line: Cedric Henderson was a 6'8" forward from the University of Georgia who was drafted by the Atlanta Hawks in 1986 and played briefly in the NBA.
